summary: Apply the process start-time range to Mission Control BPMN activity badges.
userImpact: The BPMN diagram counts only instances whose process start time falls within the range selected for the table.

changes: The activity counts by state endpoint accepts optional startedAfter and startedBefore timestamps.

security: Both URL forms enforce the existing process-definition read permission on the selected engine and definition.
documentation: OpenAPI documents both optional process start-time bounds.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing start-time filter applies to the diagram without changing the controls or steps used to set it.

rollback: Redeploy the previous frontend and backend images together.
validation: Regression coverage exercises start-time filtering for the process table and diagram badges.
A local Chromium run against Operaton verifies filtered active and completed badges and restores the full counts when the filter is cleared.
